statement.p: A certain bread recipe asks you to combine flour and yeast with 3 cups of warm 115 °F water. If the water is hotter or colder than that, then the bread won't rise.
All you have available are water from your instant hot water dispenser that is 200 °F and ice that is 32 °F.
How much water from your instant hot water dispenser and ice should you mix together to get 3 cups of 115 °F water?
cups of water from your instant hot water dispenser.

p.em: Round your answers to 2 decimal places.
